fields.text: Meet us at Berlin Buzzwords (09-11 June 2024)! [Contact us](https://preview.search-guard.com/contacts/) if you're coming!

fields.question: What is Search Guard?
fields.answer: Search Guard is a comprehensive Security and Alerting suite for Elasticsearch and Kibana that provides authentication, authorization, encryption, audit logging and alerting to ensure data security and compliance.

fields.question: What is your licensing model?
fields.answer: Search Guard is dual licensed. All basic security features in the Community Edition are free, while you need to obtain a license in order to use the Enterprise or Compliance Edition in production. We license Search Guard per production cluster, not number of nodes. Our license has no limits regarding the number of nodes, so you can scale your cluster indefinitely without additional costs. All other systems, like development, staging, integration, test and the like are included in the license. Scale your cluster, not your cost!

fields.question: Which versions of Elasticsearch does Search Guard support?
fields.answer: Search Guard supports nearly all versions of Elasticsearch, starting from Elasticsearch 2.x and including Elasticsearch 8.x. For more information, please check the [version matrix page](https://search-guard.com/docs/latest/search-guard-versions) on our docs.
